no_adcom_quote.quote: No new efficacy or safety issue rose to the level of requiring the input from an advisory panel. Therefore no advisory committee was convened.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for empagliflozin (JARDIANCE, NDA204629). The Summary Review states that no new efficacy or safety issue rose to the level of requiring input from an advisory panel, and both the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and Medical Review independently confirm no Advisory Committee was held for empagliflozin. The Medical Review references advisory committee discussions only for other SGLT2 inhibitors in the class (dapagliflozin and canagliflozin), not for this application.
